messages:
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback condition met for embeddings (eu-west) on release v3.6.0. p95 errors 3.8% (>3%). Suggest rollback to v3.5.3.
deploy-bot: Reason: high decoder error rate on quantized path.
alisa: Requesting 10m hold to validate traces and avoid unnecessary churn. overriding interlock.
mike: Agree to hold. pulling recent request samples now.
sana: Quick grep: several traces show 'quant_decode_mismatch' across GPUs. saving samples.
jordan: Ops: if error climbs above 5% we must cut traffic. what's trend?
oncall-bot: trend: 2.9% (15m), 3.4% (7m), 3.8% (now). request volume steady.
alisa: Plan: 1) stall auto-rollback 2) shift 30% of traffic to v3.5.3 3) monitor 5m 4) escalate to 100% if >5%.
mike: Command to update route: `redwood route update --service=embeddings --split=70:30 --versions=3.6.0,3.5.3`
deploy-bot: Route updated to 70% v3.6.0 / 30% v3.5.3 for embeddings (eu-west).
sana: After split, failing signature persists in 27/30 samples. looks reproducible.
oncall-bot: p95 errors now 5.4% -> SLA trigger exceeded.
alisa: Proceeding with manual rollback and pin to v3.5.3. running: `redwood release pin --service=embeddings --version=3.5.3 --note="manual rollback: quant path regression in v3.6.0"`
deploy-bot: Routing update: embeddings now 100% v3.5.3 (eu-west).
oncall-bot: Post-cutover metrics: p95 errors 1.1% (2m), 0.7% (6m).
mike: Confirmed recovery. Jordan, scale down the extra pool.
jordan: Scaling down now. ETA 4m.
sana: Collecting traces and logs for incident postmortem. attaching grep output.
alisa: Filing incident INC-2026-4210 and posting customer note to #customer-success: "We rolled back embeddings in eu-west to v3.5.3 due to a regression in the v3.6.0 quantized build affecting a subset of requests. No data loss; investigating."
mike: I'll open a ticket to add preflight smoke tests for quant/kernel combos.
alisa: Closing thread once incident + release-note updates are in. thanks team."
